title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Leadership and Organizational Behavior
description: The objective of this brief course is to furnish participants with comprehension of principles and practices of leadership and organizational behavior, and how they can be utilized to encourage effective leadership and organizational achievement.
longDescription: The aim of this short course is to provide participants with an understanding of leadership and organizational behavior principles and practices, and how they can be applied to promote effective leadership and organizational success.It explores the key concepts and theories that underpin our understanding of organizations, including their structure, culture, and behaviour. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and case studies, learners will gain a solid grounding in the key concepts and frameworks of leadership and organizational behaviour.

This short course aims to equip participants with knowledge of leadership and organizational behavior principles and practices, and their application to promote effective leadership and organizational success. The course covers essential concepts and theories, including organizational structure, culture, and behavior. Participants will learn through a combination of lectures, discussions, and case studies to gain a firm grasp of the key concepts and frameworks of leadership and organizational behavior. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding Leadership and Organizational Behaviour: Fundamentals of Organizational Theories: Understanding Organization System Thinking and Structure:
